quote: The professor said exam math will be minimal and easy.
source: transcript 9/24 (~87%) says it, but it explains nothing the question asked.
fix: Relative potency = ED50B / ED50A. Drug A is 1000 times more potent than drug B because it requires 1000 times less drug to produce equivalent responses.

quote: The less selective a drug is, the more effects (side effects) it produces.
source: transcript 9/24 (~98%) says it, but selectivity/side effects is not one of the options and is Exam 2 (ADR) material.
fix: Cells have receptors that recognize specific chemicals based on shape, size and other properties. Multiple chemicals may bind the same receptor (several beta blockers), and one chemical may bind multiple receptors (acetylcholine at nicotinic and muscarinic); ligands can be endogenous or exogenous.
